payload.content: QA Interview Trainer project at ~/trainer/qa-interview-trainer/. Runs natively (not Docker): PostgreSQL 16 at /Library/PostgreSQL/16 (pg_hba.conf set to trust), backend on :8000 (uvicorn), frontend on :3000 (vite), mock API on :8080 (Python FastAPI). Start command for each is in the project. DB: trainer/trainer@localhost:5432, schemas: ecommerce + banking. Backend fixed to set search_path=ecommerce,banking,public before queries.
